## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The new flag should honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` so CI can configure exclusions through the environment as project policy requires.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that skips files by basename and logs each skip in verbose mode. It documents the flag and adds parser, file collection, and archive tests.

(none)

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the exclusion default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE='*.log'` and no `--exclude` argument, the parser supplies `[]` and archives `debug.log`. `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11` requires that “Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that configure exclusions through the environment will produce archives containing files they intended to omit.
